repos_data.description: Dumb-as-rocks OHLC analyzer. POST your bars + the indicators you want, get back exactly what you asked for. RSI/MACD/Bollinger/ADX/ATR/VWAP/...

repo_meta_data.description: Interactive Brokers, curl-friendly — over REST + MCP. FastAPI + ib_async over a Linux-native IB Gateway: stocks/options/futures/forex/crypto/CFD contracts, quotes, historical bars, orders, positions, executions. Typed MCP tools mirror the whole surface. The IBKR half of mt5-httpapi — same shape, no Windows VM.
